question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) as payment_month,
        SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, payment_month
),
ordered_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_totals
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        monthly_total - prev_month_total as monthly_change
    FROM ordered_totals
    WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        AVG(monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
    FROM monthly_changes
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    ac.avg_monthly_change
FROM avg_changes ac
JOIN customer c ON ac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ac.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
